rules.prepare:
case "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" in mips64*) export ABI=64 ;; esac
# The patches from Debian change configure.ac and Makefile.am. (cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" && autoreconf -vfi)
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --enable-cxx \ --enable-shared \ --enable-static \ --build="$AELTRA_BUILD_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE"
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install bh_unify_lib64_with_lib "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR"
# As in Debian: the compiler flags are in gmp.h. sed -i "s,$AELTRA_WORK_DIR,BUILDPATH,g" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/gmp.h"
